Mission -

Zamp is not a company, we’re a humanity catalyst. We’re on a mission to enable people to move at the speed of thought.

This decade, we’re focused on building digital employees for the future of work, unlocking human creativity at a scale the world has never seen. About the Team:

 At Zamp, our engineering team is the force behind our technological innovations. Transforming the most ambitious ideas into reality, we breathe life into dreams through code and hardware. With the right mix of expertise and creativity, this team is the unseen magicians who add a dash of tech wizardry to make Zamp’s products shine.

From coding late into the night to brainstorming over a cup of coffee, we are always on a mission to make our technology stand out. We are not just the engineering team but the tech superheroes that keep Zamp at the forefront of innovation.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Designing and developing high-quality, scalable, and performant front-end solutions using modern web technologies

  • Collaborating with product managers, UX/UI designers, and back-end engineers to translate requirements and designs into functional, user-friendly interfaces

  • Acting as a technical expert, staying updated on industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in front-end development

  • Driving continuous improvement in development processes, code quality, and front-end architecture

  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define and implement best practices, standards, and coding conventions

  • Conducting performance optimisations and ensuring the scalability and responsiveness of our front-end applications

  • Championing usability and accessibility standards, ensuring our applications are intuitive and accessible to a diverse user base

  • Staying informed about user feedback and conducting user testing to make data-driven decisions for UI/UX improvements

  • Staying aligned with project timelines and delivering high-quality work within agreed-upon deadlines

Qualifications:

  • 3-7 years of experience as a Front-End Engineer, with a strong track record of delivering high-quality front-end solutions

  • Proficiency in web technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and front-end frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.js

  • Experience in leading a team or mentoring junior developers, demonstrating strong leadership and communication skills

  • Deep understanding of front-end architecture, design patterns, and best practices

  • Strong knowledge of responsive design principles and cross-browser compatibility

  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile development methodologies

  • Familiarity with UI/UX design principles and the ability to collaborate effectively with designers

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude towards finding solutions

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks while adhering to deadlines

  • Strong attention to detail and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences

Our Culture and Benefits: 

At Zamp, we promote a culture of open communication, collaboration, and empowerment. We value transparency, meritocracy, and a strong work ethic. Join our early team and help us build something exceptional. 

Perks: 

  • Competitive salaries and stock options with substantial potential upside. 

  • Collaborate with top talent. 

  • Diverse and inclusive workspace. 

  • Comprehensive medical insurance for employees, spouses, and children. 

  • A culture celebrating every victory.

  • Enjoy good food, games, and a comfortable office environment.

As an AI Solution Analyst – AI Workflows at Zamp.ai, you will operate as a key business partner on the front line. Your primary focus is to deeply understand customer processes, capture workflow requirements, and translate them into precise, high-quality AI workflows on our platform using our code generation platform.

About the Role:

We're hiring one Product Manager at Zamp, and we mean something specific by it.

90% of PM jobs in India are redundant. Most "product managers" are project managers in disguise - chasing tickets, scheduling standups, writing status updates nobody reads. 

We don't need a coordinator. We need an owner.

You won't manage a product. You'll own one like a mini-CEO. You'll have a goal, an AI employee handling the busywork, and the authority to decide what gets built. No permission slips. No six-week alignment cycles. If you need to ask whether you're allowed to do something, this isn't your seat.

What we actually care about:

Product sense isn't a degree, a title, or years on a résumé. It's how you think and how completely you own the thing you ship. Designer, engineer, architect, implementation lead doesn't matter. If you see the product clearly and you're right, we're open to hiring you.

We don't care whether you have 1 year of experience or 10. We care about exactly two things:

  1. Vision — you can answer "Where should Zamp's product be in a year?" and articulate product direction clearly.

  2. Judgment — we value critical thinking over project execution. You decide what matters, and you're right often enough that the founders lose the argument.

This role IS:

  • Deciding what to build, then shipping it

  • Owning a number and moving it

  • Talking to users and acting the same day

  • Delegating the busywork to an AI employee

  • Being the person the founders argue with — and lose to

This role is NOT:

  • Writing JIRA tickets other people scoped

  • Running standups and calling it leadership

  • Waiting for sign-off before you move

  • Owning a roadmap you didn't decide

  • Translating between eng and design all day

The assignment (instead of a résumé):

Send us the work. No portal. No form. No résumé required. Build a working MVP — ship something real, not a spec. Pair it with a pitch for why it matters and how you'd take it further. A two-minute Loom is fine. Notion is fine. We just want to see how you think and what you make.

Treat the pitch like a fundraise: you're the founder, the product is the company, and you're making the case for why it should exist and where it goes next. Full details here - https://pm-hiring-zamp-palak.zampapps.com/

Email your MVP + pitch to palak@zamp.ai. If it's sharp, we want to talk.

As a Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineer at Zamp, and an early member of this function, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer deployments while helping define how Zamp's platform is deployed and operated across enterprise environments.

Many of our largest customers operate in regulated industries and require Zamp to run inside their own infrastructure rather than our cloud. You will work directly with these customers to architect, deploy, upgrade, and manage the Zamp platform in their environments, ensuring every deployment meets their security, compliance, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You will typically serve as the directly responsible technical owner for a small number of strategic enterprise customers, leading each deployment from architecture and discovery through implementation, production readiness, and ongoing operations. Alongside that, you will establish the standards, tooling, and processes that make deployments repeatable, and partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Success.

What you'll do :

  • Own deployment architecture conversations and execution, designing and implementing deployment strategies across customer environments, including Kubernetes topology, networking, permissioning, storage, identity, and infrastructure provisioning.

  • Manage the full infrastructure lifecycle for some of Zamp's most critical customers: initial deployment, ongoing upgrades, scaling, and incident support.

  • Personally configure and troubleshoot Helm releases, workloads, services, ingress, secrets, observability, and autoscaling within customer-controlled clusters.

  • Work with customers' platform engineering, security, and DevOps teams to navigate their infrastructure constraints, compliance requirements, and change management processes.

  • Translate customer security, reliability, and operational requirements into practical deployment architectures, and know when a requirement is a configuration change versus a genuine product gap.

  • Diagnose complex issues across Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, application services, databases, authentication, networking, and service dependencies, often with limited access to the environment.

  • Develop and maintain Helm configurations, deployment automation, validation tooling, runbooks, and upgrade procedures that make operations repeatable and reliable.

  • Own the deployment supply chain: image promotion, vulnerability scanning, artifact signing, and the mirroring workflows that air-gapped and restricted customers depend on.

  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure Zamp's platform is deployable and operable across diverse customer requirements, converting customer-specific solutions into reusable platform improvements.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success to scope infrastructure requirements during pre-sales and onboarding, translating customer needs into concrete deployment plans.

What you'll bring :

  • 4+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or solutions architecture, with significant time spent on customer-facing deployment work.

  • Demonstrated experience personally deploying and operating production applications on Kubernetes, including workloads, services, ingress, DNS, network policies, persistent storage, secrets, identity, autoscaling, and observability.

  • Production experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), including networking fundamentals such as VPCs, IAM, DNS, and load balancing.

  • Hands-on experience with Helm and at least one infrastructure or deployment automation system such as Terraform, Argo CD, Flux, Kustomize, or equivalent.

  • Track record of managing deployments in customer-owned environments, including navigating security reviews, compliance requirements, and change management processes.

  • Strong debugging skills across containers, distributed services, networking, logs, metrics, authentication, storage, and service dependencies.

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity with enterprise stakeholders, from platform engineers to CISOs, and turn infrastructure conversations into actionable deployment plans.

  • Strong operational instincts: you think about upgrades, rollbacks, monitoring, and failure modes from the start, not as an afterthought.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to both engineers and non-engineering stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and collaborating across engineering, product, and go-to-market teams.

About Zamp:

About the role:

The ideal candidate will work closely with the Founder, gaining a front-row seat to the entire business and contributing to various initiatives and projects across different departments, including strategy, operations, finance, analytics, and more.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to be involved in shaping the company's trajectory and driving strategic initiatives that contribute to the company's growth and success. You’ll solve a variety of problems and move the needle, helping Zamp move forward! 

Key Responsibilities :

  • Work closely with the Founder to support various strategic initiatives and projects

  • Owning responsibilities across domains such as strategy, marketing, operations, and partnerships to unlock opportunities for Zamp.

  • Strategic Partnerships and Alliances: Identify and cultivate strategic partnerships and alliances that align with the company's goals and vision

  • Innovation and New Initiatives: Drive innovation and new initiatives within the organization

  • Investor Relations and Fundraising: Assist in managing investor relations and fundraising activities and working closely with the Founder

  • Global Expansion and Market Entry: Support the Founder in exploring and executing global expansion strategies, including market entry into new countries and regions, assessing regulatory landscapes and market opportunities, and overseeing successful market entry initiatives.

  • Talent Acquisition and Development: Contribute to talent acquisition and development initiatives, participating in the recruitment process for key roles

  • Customer Experience and Satisfaction: Prioritize customer experience and satisfaction, working closely with the customer service and product teams to understand customer needs and feedback, and implementing strategies to enhance the overall customer experience and build strong customer relationships

Qualifications & Skill Set Required :

  •  4+ years of relevant experience working in a management/strategy/consulting domain or in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Very strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics. An MBA is a plus.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels

  • A proactive attitude, strong work ethic, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic startup environment

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and take initiative, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for delivering results.

    understand what it is like to work in one

  • You are excited to learn new things and do not shy away from going above and beyond the

    traditional growth paths. You have strong communication skills.

  • You can quickly adapt to the changing environment and are quick to pick up new skills if

    required to get the job done.

  • You have the ability to break down a problem into smaller chunks and the ability to balance

    between the big picture and tactical activities.

something exceptional.

What You’ll Be Responsible For:

As an Architect at Zamp, you will play a pivotal role in designing the world’s most advanced digital employee, a leading AI agent redefining the future of work. You will:

  • Design & Evolve Core Architecture: Define the long-term architectural vision that enables our digital employees to work seamlessly across enterprise systems at scale.

  • Bridge Strategy and Execution: Translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient designs, while rolling up your sleeves to get hands-on when needed.

  • Enable Velocity & Quality: Balance speed of iteration with long-term technical excellence, ensuring we can move fast without compromising reliability.

  • Drive Standards & Best Practices: Establish frameworks and patterns that enable teams to build consistently and with high quality across Zamp’s platform.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with engineering, product, and customer teams to align architecture with real-world enterprise needs.

  • Mentorship & Multiplication: Up-level the technical bar by coaching engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, and growing the next generation of technical leaders.

What We’re Looking For:

We care more about how you think, solve problems, and align with our values than a checklist of technologies.

Some of our values:

  • Act like an owner – You think like a owner and founder, take full responsibility, and see problems through to the end.

  • Velocity is survival – You bias for action and shorten learning loops without sacrificing quality.

  • Break down problems, solve simply – You break problems down to their atoms and rebuild them simply.

  • Build with all your heart – You build with heart, obsessing over details that most people don’t even see.

  • Radical transparency – You thrive in open, transparent discussions, and elevate the thinking of those around you.

  • Imagine the future, and make it reality – You believe the world is malleable and want to design systems that endure.

In addition, we care intensely about what has been your life’s best work so far. We want people who have truly seen, and built great systems from scratch, and solved some of the hardest problems out there. We believe past behavior is one of the best predictor of future behavior, so we’d love to go deep into what you believe to be your best work.

We’re less concerned with whether you know Python, Go, or JavaScript today, what matters is your ability to learn fast, adapt, and bring clarity to complex technical challenges.

something exceptional.

Zamp is not a company, we’re a humanity catalyst. We’re on a mission to enable people to move at the speed of thought.

This decade, we’re focused on building digital employees for the future of work, unlocking human creativity at a scale the world has never seen. Hear more from our founders on our company here.

Role Overview:

At Zamp, our engineering team is the force behind our technological innovations. Transforming the most ambitious ideas into reality, we breathe life into dreams through code and hardware. With the right mix of expertise and creativity, this team is the unseen magicians who add a dash of tech wizardry to make Zamp’s products shine. 

From coding late into the night to brainstorming over a cup of coffee, we are always on a mission to make our technology stand out. We are not just the engineering team but the tech superheroes that 

keep Zamp at the forefront of innovation. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Self-Hosted Infrastructure Ownership: Design, deploy, and maintain self-hosted systems and services, ensuring reliability, scalability, and security. 

  • Kubernetes & Container Orchestration: Architect, manage, and scale Kubernetes clusters in production and self-hosted environments. 

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Write and manage Terraform modules to provision and manage infrastructure across AWS/GCP and on-prem setups. 

  • CI/CD Automation: Build and maintain reliable CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or ArgoCD to ensure fast and safe deployments. 

  • Monitoring & Observability: Set up and fine-tune observability tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Graylog to monitor infrastructure, detect anomalies, and ensure SLAs. 

  • Scripting & Engineering: Write clean, modular automation scripts in Python, Bash, or Go to support operational needs and improve team productivity. 

  • System Reliability & Incident Response: Own on-call responsibilities, drive root cause analysis, and continuously improve incident handling and system resilience. 

  • Security & Compliance: Implement security and access controls within infrastructure, focusing on hardened self-hosted environments.

Qualifications:

  • 4-6 years of experience 

  • Proven experience managing self-hosted systems and internal tooling at scale 

  • Deep hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes, including Helm, Ingress, scaling, and custom operators 

  • Solid experience with Terraform for IaC; openly Ansible for configuration. 

  • Expertise in monitoring/logging stacks: Grafana, Prometheus, Graylog, ELK 

  • Hands-on with AWS, GCP, or Azure; strong understanding of cloud-nave + on-prem hybrid setups 

  • Strong scripting experience in Python, Bash, or Go 

  • Proficiency in version control systems like Git for managing code repositories and facilitang collaboration among development teams 

Our Culture and Benefits: 

At Zamp, we promote a culture of open communication, collaboration, and empowerment. We value transparency, meritocracy, and a strong work ethic. Join our early team and help us build something exceptional. 

Perks: 

  • Competitive salaries and stock options with substantial potential upside. 

  • Collaborate with top talent. 

  • Diverse and inclusive workspace. 

  • Comprehensive medical insurance for employees, spouses, and children. 

  • A culture celebrating every victory. 

  • Continuous learning and skill development opportunities. 

  • Enjoy good food, games, and a comfortable office environment.

Role Overview :

As an AI Solution Analyst – AI Workflows at Zamp.ai, you will operate as a key business partner on the front line. Your primary focus is to deeply understand customer processes, capture workflow requirements, and translate them into precise, high-quality AI workflows on our platform using our code generation platform.

You will collaborate with internal teams and customers to unpack real operational challenges, formalise problem statements, and ensure the workflows created truly reflect business needs. The role is rooted in business analysis, process understanding, and structured problem-solving, with a strong emphasis on clarity, accuracy, and customer impact.

At its core, this is a business-driven role that leverages AI to transform customer operations into reliable, measurable, and scalable workflows.

Responsibilities :

  • Workflow Definition & Implementation: Translate customer and internal business process requirements into workflow specifications, then use our internal AI tooling to generate code and assemble workflow logic and automation.

  • End-to-End Ownership: Validate workflows end-to-end — from design through testing, to production rollout and performance monitoring.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the critical link between business teams, product & engineering. Provide feedback on workflow patterns, tool improvement and platform capabilities.

  • Customer & Stakeholder Enablement: Work with customer-facing teams to onboard workflow solutions, ensure they run smoothly, and support adoption and feedback-loops.

  • Business Impact Tracking: Monitor workflow performance, measure KPIs/ROI, communicate value and insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications :

  • 0–2 years of professional experience (including internships) in business/analyst roles or equivalent.

  • Strong academic foundation; candidates from top-tier institutes (IITs and other premier colleges) preferred.

  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science (or equivalent) strongly preferred, with proficiency in basic programming (e.g., Python, JavaScript) and a passion for building solutions.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, clarity of thought, and structured approach to workflow or process modelling.

  • Initiative and ownership mindset: you thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and proactively drive results.

  • Strong communication skills and customer orientation: you can translate business needs into technical/solution language and interact effectively across teams.

The assignment (instead of a résumé):

Send us the work. No portal. No form. No résumé required.

Full details here - https://zamp-analyst-careers.zampapps.com/

Email your submission to palak@zamp.ai If it's sharp, we want to talk.

Our Culture & Benefits :

At Zamp.ai, we foster a culture of transparency, meritocracy, and empowerment. Join a lean, high-velocity team where your impact is visible, your work matters, and you’ll grow quickly.

Perks include:

  • Competitive salary + stock options with upside.

  • Collaborative environment working with top-tier talent.

  • Inclusive and diverse workspace.

  • Comprehensive medical insurance for employees, spouse and dependents.

  • Continuous learning and development opportunities.

  • Office with comfortable work setting and excellent amenities.

About the role:

We are seeking a driven, entrepreneurial leader to join Zamp as a AI Solution Manager (ASM) / General Manager (GM), owning Enterprise customers end-to-end with full P&L responsibility. You'll be accountable for revenue targets, customer success, and operational excellence - essentially running your own business within Zamp. This role is for someone who wants to build, not just manage; who obsesses over customers and outcomes, not activity.

This role carries real accountability - you will make tradeoffs, own decisions, and be measured on outcomes. You will operate within a pod-based model, where each pod consists of 5-6 members is overseen by a GM.

You'll work closely with the founding team while having significant autonomy to make decisions, hire your team, and chart the path to hitting your numbers. If you've wanted to run a business but with the backing of a well-funded, fast-growing company - this is it.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own a P&L with clear revenue or contract targets - you are the CEO of your pod.

  • Drive exceptional customer experience across the full lifecycle - from initial pitch through implementation to ongoing success and renewals

  • Be deeply embedded with customers on-site when required to unblock progress, influence stakeholders, and ensure successful outcomes

  • Lead and manage your pod to ensure high-quality execution, strong customer outcomes, and healthy delivery economics

  • Work with Product to translate customer needs into roadmap priorities; be the voice of your market internally

  • Contribute to company-wide strategy and planning as a member of the leadership team

Qualifications & Skill Set Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in roles where you owned outcomes (revenue, delivery, or customer success) in management, strategy, consulting, or fast-paced startup environments

  • High ownership mindset; you don't wait for permission or pass problems upstream

  • Excellent analytical skills; ability to make data-driven decisions while moving fast

  • Outstanding communication skills - you can pitch a customer, rally a team, and present to the CXOs

  • Experience building and managing teams; you attract talent and get the best out of people

  • You understand AI/automation and get excited about what digital employees can do for businesses

Good to have:

  • You are an entrepreneur at heart, i.e you are not only excited about startups but also really understand what it is like to work in one

  • Experience in enterprise SaaS, fintech, or B2B services

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and actually prefer it to bureaucracy

  • You have strong opinions on how to build a great customer experience

  • You are excited to learn new things and do not shy away from going above and beyond the traditional growth paths.

Our Culture and Benefits:

At Zamp.ai, we foster a culture of transparency, meritocracy, and empowerment. Join a lean, high-velocity team where your impact is visible, your work matters, and you’ll grow quickly.

Perks include:

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity ownership tied to long-term company success

  • Collaborative environment working with top-tier talent.

  • Inclusive and diverse workspace.

  • Comprehensive health insurance for employees, spouse and dependents.

  • Continuous learning and development opportunities.

  • Office with comfortable work setting and excellent amenities.

schema.description:
About Zamp:

Mission -

Zamp is not a company, we’re a humanity catalyst. We’re on a mission to enable people to move at the speed of thought.

This decade, we’re focused on building digital employees for the future of work, unlocking human creativity at a scale the world has never seen. We work with 50+ top global organizations and banks (including DoorDash, Uber, and Stripe) with billions in revenue. We raised a $22M seed round in 2022 from Sequoia Capital, Dara Khosrowshahi (CEO, Uber), Tony Xu (CEO, DoorDash), and other global leaders.

One aspect of our purpose is to build what we believe to be the world’s best team, passionate, authentic, and relentlessly curious people who want to do their life’s best work, learn as much as possible, and create outsized impact.

Hear more from our founders here.

About the Role:

We're hiring one Product Manager at Zamp, and we mean something specific by it.

90% of PM jobs in India are redundant. Most "product managers" are project managers in disguise - chasing tickets, scheduling standups, writing status updates nobody reads. 

We don't need a coordinator. We need an owner.

We are looking for a Client Partner to build, manage, and grow our international customer accounts.   1. Relationship Management

  • Build and deepen trusted relationships with strategic customer accounts and senior stakeholders, including CXO-level leaders.

  • Act as the voice of the customer internally, influencing product, implementation, and delivery priorities.

  1. Revenue Growth

  • Own revenue targets and drive account growth through renewals, upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities.

  • Lead account planning, stakeholder mapping, executive business reviews, and long-term growth strategies.

  • Apply strong commercial judgment and executive presence to identify, shape, and close expansion opportunities.

  1. Implementation & Customer Success

  • Partner closely with implementation, product, delivery, and leadership teams to ensure successful customer outcomes.

  • Translate customer business problems into implementation strategies and scalable solution opportunities.

  • Spend time at customer sites as needed to strengthen relationships, understand workflows, drive adoption, and ensure successful execution.

What we look for

  • 8–12+ years of experience in strategic account management, client partnership, consulting, implementation, enterprise sales, or account growth roles.

  • Prior experience managing or growing large enterprise customer accounts.

  • Demonstrated experience owning revenue, quota, renewals, upsell, cross-sell, farming, or account expansion.

  • Ability to understand business problems, build trust, and convert customer needs into commercial opportunities.

  • Ability to manage senior stakeholders and hold CXO-level conversations.

  • Strong communication skills, executive presence, and structured problem-solving ability.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.

  • Strong collaboration skills across product, implementation, delivery, and leadership teams.

  • Willingness to travel frequently for customer meetings and onsite engagements, where required.

Good to have

  • Experience working with global enterprise customers in healthcare, logistics, supply chain, financial services, insurance, pharma, analytics, or BPM-led environments.

  • Background in consulting, analytics, IT services, BPM, SaaS implementation, or enterprise transformation.

  • Experience growing accounts from initial implementation to multi-team or multi-business-unit expansion.

Our Culture and Benefits:

At Zamp.ai, we foster a culture of transparency, meritocracy, and empowerment. Join a lean, high-velocity team where your impact is visible, your work matters, and you’ll grow quickly.

Perks include:

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity ownership tied to long-term company success

  • Collaborative environment working with top-tier talent.

  • Inclusive and diverse workspace.

  • Comprehensive health insurance for employees, spouse and dependents.

  • Continuous learning and development opportunities.

About Zamp:

Mission -

Zamp is not a company, we’re a humanity catalyst. We’re on a mission to enable people to move at the speed of thought.

This decade, we’re focused on building digital employees for the future of work, unlocking human creativity at a scale the world has never seen. We raised a $22M seed round in 2022 from Sequoia Capital, Dara Khosrowshahi (CEO, Uber), Tony Xu (CEO, DoorDash), and other global leaders.

One aspect of our purpose is to build what we believe to be the world’s best team, passionate, authentic, and relentlessly curious people who want to do their life’s best work, learn as much as possible, and create outsized impact.

Hear more from our founders on our company here.

About the role :

As a Forward Deployed Infrastructure Engineer at Zamp, and an early member of this function, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of customer deployments while helping define how Zamp's platform is deployed and operated across enterprise environments.

Many of our largest customers operate in regulated industries and require Zamp to run inside their own infrastructure rather than our cloud. You will work directly with these customers to architect, deploy, upgrade, and manage the Zamp platform in their environments, ensuring every deployment meets their security, compliance, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You will typically serve as the directly responsible technical owner for a small number of strategic enterprise customers, leading each deployment from architecture and discovery through implementation, production readiness, and ongoing operations. Alongside that, you will establish the standards, tooling, and processes that make deployments repeatable, and partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Success.

Previous AI or machine learning experience is helpful but not required. Strong production infrastructure and Kubernetes deployment experience matters considerably more.

What you'll do :

  • Own deployment architecture conversations and execution, designing and implementing deployment strategies across customer environments, including Kubernetes topology, networking, permissioning, storage, identity, and infrastructure provisioning.

  • Manage the full infrastructure lifecycle for some of Zamp's most critical customers: initial deployment, ongoing upgrades, scaling, and incident support.

  • Personally configure and troubleshoot Helm releases, workloads, services, ingress, secrets, observability, and autoscaling within customer-controlled clusters.

  • Work with customers' platform engineering, security, and DevOps teams to navigate their infrastructure constraints, compliance requirements, and change management processes.

  • Translate customer security, reliability, and operational requirements into practical deployment architectures, and know when a requirement is a configuration change versus a genuine product gap.

  • Diagnose complex issues across Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, application services, databases, authentication, networking, and service dependencies, often with limited access to the environment.

  • Develop and maintain Helm configurations, deployment automation, validation tooling, runbooks, and upgrade procedures that make operations repeatable and reliable.

  • Own the deployment supply chain: image promotion, vulnerability scanning, artifact signing, and the mirroring workflows that air-gapped and restricted customers depend on.

  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure Zamp's platform is deployable and operable across diverse customer requirements, converting customer-specific solutions into reusable platform improvements.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success to scope infrastructure requirements during pre-sales and onboarding, translating customer needs into concrete deployment plans.

What you'll bring :

  • 4+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, site reliability engineering, or solutions architecture, with significant time spent on customer-facing deployment work.

  • Demonstrated experience personally deploying and operating production applications on Kubernetes, including workloads, services, ingress, DNS, network policies, persistent storage, secrets, identity, autoscaling, and observability.

  • Production experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), including networking fundamentals such as VPCs, IAM, DNS, and load balancing.

  • Hands-on experience with Helm and at least one infrastructure or deployment automation system such as Terraform, Argo CD, Flux, Kustomize, or equivalent.

  • Track record of managing deployments in customer-owned environments, including navigating security reviews, compliance requirements, and change management processes.

  • Strong debugging skills across containers, distributed services, networking, logs, metrics, authentication, storage, and service dependencies.

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity with enterprise stakeholders, from platform engineers to CISOs, and turn infrastructure conversations into actionable deployment plans.

  • Strong operational instincts: you think about upgrades, rollbacks, monitoring, and failure modes from the start, not as an afterthought.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to both engineers and non-engineering stakeholders.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and collaborating across engineering, product, and go-to-market teams.

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Experience deploying applications onto a Kubernetes platform managed entirely by another team is not sufficient on its own. Candidates should have direct experience diagnosing and resolving Kubernetes and infrastructure-level issues.

Culture and Benefits :

At Zamp.ai, we foster a culture of transparency, meritocracy, and empowerment. Join a lean, high-velocity team where your impact is visible, your work matters, and you’ll grow quickly.

Perks include:

  • Competitive salary + stock options with upside.

  • Collaborative environment working with top-tier talent.

  • Inclusive and diverse workspace.

  • Comprehensive medical insurance for employees, spouse and dependents.

  • Continuous learning and development opportunities.

  • Office with comfortable work setting and excellent amenities.
